title: Rabbi Yehuda bar Zevina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Chullin 99b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.99b.9-11), a man came before Rabbi Chanina while Rabbi Yehudah bar Zevina was sitting at the door. When he came out, Rabbi Yehuda asked him, "What did he say to you?" He said to him, "He permitted it to him." Rabbi Yehuda sent him back to Rabbi Chanina, who said, "Who is this who is troubling me? Go tell the one sitting at the door: sinews do not impart flavor." And in [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1700&lang=en) it says that Rabbi Yehudah bar Zevina — and Rabbi Ami and Rabbi Chanina and Rav Yitzchak bar Chaluv, [Chullin 99b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.99b.9-11). With all due respect, he mixed two matters together, for there it is a separate statement, as they say there afterwards: when they came before Rabbi Ami, he sent them before Rav Yitzchak bar Chaluv.[^5]

He is also mentioned in [Sotah 12a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.12a.9-16), with several homilies from him, but it seems that one should read there, as in [Berakhot 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.12b.14), Rabbi Yehudah bar Zevida; and in Dikdukei Soferim (דק״ס) the reading in [Berakhot 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.12b.14) and also in Bava Batra 102a is, in all of them, Rabbi Yehudah bar Zevina.[^4]

notes.text: Hyman distinguishes the questioner-at-the-door episode from the separate Rabbi Ami/Rav Yitzchak bar Chaluv statement. Zevida and Zevina are witness variants.
The notice gives Rav Yitzchak bar Chaluv; the checked William Davidson paragraph has Rabbi Yitzchak ben Chaluv. The different forms are preserved as witness readings.

The consulted Chullin 99b passage separates the questioner-at-the-door story from the subsequent Ami/Yitzchak ben Chaluv report. Hyman’s Rav/bar wording and Zevina/Zevida variants remain distinct from the consulted Rabbi/ben wording; his exact Dikdukei Soferim readings were not independently inspected.

Chullin puts the exchange at the door before the separate report that Rabbi Ami sent questioners to Rabbi Yitzchak ben Chaluv. Sotah gives Rav Yehudah bar Zevina, while Berakhot and Bava Batra 120a have Zevida. Hyman’s Dikdukei Soferim readings are reported on his authority. See also [Bava Batra 120a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.120a.2-3).
Heilprin’s notice puts these names together under Chullin 99b. Hyman reads the passage as two episodes: Yehudah at the doorway, then Rabbi Ami sending questioners to Yitzchak ben Chaluv.
